headlines.title: Sec. Duffy says ‘I can’t apologize’ for decades-old air traffic control infrastructure
headlines.description: Secretary of Transportation Sean Duffy tells Meet the Press he hopes Congress will take up bipartisan legislation to allocate more money for new FAA systems after a router upgrade disruption caused a nationwide ground stop.

headlines.title: Trump plans to take Qatari jet to Asia, but it’s unclear whether it’s been ‘maxed out’
headlines.description: President Donald Trump is expected to take the Qatari-gifted Air Force One to Asia on Monday as questions linger about upgrades the White House said were needed after a security threat from Iran forced the president to fly home from Turkey on a secret military plane in July, according to two U.S. officials.

headlines.title: Here’s the biggest news you missed this weekend
headlines.description: Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy declined to apologize for the nationwide ground stop on Friday that stranded hundreds of thousands of travelers.

headlines.title: Scott Colom: ‘I’m not here to look out for the billionaires’
headlines.description: After a historic win in Mississippi, Sen.-elect Scott Colom (D) discusses his campaign promise of restoring affordability in his state.

headlines.title: Women with autoimmune diseases often have symptoms dismissed as ‘psychological’
headlines.description: Women with autoimmune diseases such as lupus or rheumatoid arthritis are more likely to be misdiagnosed or get delayed treatment compared with men, with their symptoms often dismissed as “psychological.”

headlines.title: The biggest move of the NFL trade deadline paid immediate dividends
headlines.description: Making his first start for the Minnesota Vikings since 2023, quarterback Kirk Cousins picked up where he left off — almost literally.

headlines.title: Russell Brand says ‘I am not guilty’ in statement from prison read by his wife
headlines.description: Russell Brand declared “I am not guilty” in a new statement read by his wife on his YouTube channel Sunday, days after a London court sentenced him to prison on rape and sexual assault charges.

headlines.title: We want to hear your experience with changes to student loan repayment plans
headlines.description: If you’re a student borrower who was required to transition to another plan this year, share your story.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.
